prompt:

assert torch.__version__ == "2.2.0"


def eigendecomposition():
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    base = torch.randn(4, 4, dtype=torch.double)
    matrix = base @ base.t()
    eigenvalues, eigenvectors =
assertions:
eigenvalues, eigenvectors, matrix = eigendecomposition()
assert eigenvalues.dtype == torch.complex128
assert eigenvectors.dtype == torch.complex128
assert eigenvalues.shape == (4,)
assert eigenvectors.shape == (4, 4)
